title: The Prepper
setup: In a garage near {place}, a neighbour in full camouflage shows {name} his bunker. He has been ready for this for years.

options.label: Sit through the full briefing
options.outcome: Ninety minutes at a whiteboard, with handouts. He sends {name} off with a bottle and a promise to drop by for a drill.

options.label: Swap cache spots on the map
options.outcome: He marks two caches on {name}'s map in tiny, proud triangles. The map now knows things. So does he.

options.label: Back out politely

effects.why: the prepper logged the hatch on his group channel

options.outcome: He logs the family on his group channel as "unprepared". The channel has more listeners than he thinks.

title: Readiness Drill
setup: The camouflaged neighbour is at the hatch at 5 a.m. with a whistle and a clipboard. Surprise readiness drill.

options.label: Run his drill
options.outcome: Everyone is out of the shelter in ninety seconds, then back in. He awards one bottle of water for participation.

options.label: Let him inspect the shelter
options.outcome: He confiscates a dented can as "a hazard" and leaves a spare medkit. Everyone feels audited.

options.label: Pretend nobody's home

effects.why: the prepper's whistle drew the whole street

options.outcome: He blows the whistle at the hatch for an hour, for realism. The whole street hears it.

title: Off Season
setup: A man in a Santa suit is at the hatch with a sack. He worked the grotto at {nearest_grocery} and kept the suit on.

options.label: Let him in to warm up
options.outcome: He eats two rations, tells grotto stories and checks everyone against a list. Everyone, it turns out, is on the Nice list.

options.label: Put the console in his sack

effects.what: went in Santa's sack for the next child on his list

options.outcome: The console goes in the sack for whichever child is next on his list. He leaves a can of {food_label}, wrapped.

options.label: Wave him on
options.outcome: He nods and moves on to the next hatch. Nobody enjoys being the house that turned Santa away.

title: The Nice List
setup: Word got round that this hatch is on Santa's Nice list. Two families are at the door, holding out stockings.

options.label: Fill the stockings
options.outcome: A can and a bottle, split between two stockings. Somewhere, a man in a red suit is very pleased with himself.

options.label: Pass a ration each out through the vent
options.outcome: Two rations of {food_label} go out through the vent, one per stocking. It isn't much. It is festive.

options.label: Explain the list was a mistake

effects.why: the families told others about the hatch

options.outcome: Nobody believes that Santa makes mistakes. They leave, and they remember the hatch.

title: Going Live
setup: In {place}, a woman in a sequinned poncho is livestreaming the apocalypse off a satellite dish. Her follower count is still climbing.

options.label: Give her an interview

effects.why: the livestream showed which street the family lives on

options.outcome: {name} answers eleven questions about shelter life on camera. She pays in sponsored water and says she'll be in touch.

options.label: Lend her the gas mask for the thumbnail
options.outcome: The gas mask stars in her thumbnail. She pays in sponsored water and a look at the real fallout map on her uplink.

options.label: Stay out of shot
options.outcome: {name} takes the long way round her shot, through the dustiest corner of {place}.

title: Special Guest
setup: The livestreamer is at the hatch at night with a ring light and a fresh battery. She wants to film a real family shelter.

options.label: Let her film for an hour

effects.why: the ring light lit up the hatch for an hour

options.outcome: Everyone is briefly famous. The ring light can be seen from three streets away, which is a problem for longer.

options.label: Do it audio-only, hatch shut
options.outcome: An audio-only segment, shouted through the hatch. Her viewers call it atmospheric. She calls it a compromise.

options.label: Turn her away

effects.why: she filmed the hatch from the street anyway

options.outcome: She films the hatch from the street instead, with a sad caption. Everyone feels judged by strangers they'll never meet.
